card.name: Period after opioid-benzodiazepine warning
card.fires_on: Mainly the period ending the sentence 'profound sedation, respiratory depression, coma, and death' in opioid and benzodiazepine boxed warnings. It also fires on a similar sentence-final period about neonatal opioid withdrawal.

modes.label: Sentence-ending period
modes.description: The full stop after the list of sedation, respiratory depression, coma and death in the concomitant-use warning.
modes.example: respiratory depression, coma, and death<<.>> Reserve concomitant prescribing of these drugs

modes.label: Stray digit or name piece
modes.description: Isolated hits on a digit inside a blood pressure value or partway through a place name.

card.plain: It marks the end of the standard warning sentence about opioids and benzodiazepines causing sedation and death.
